newsitem.title: CHINA: Japan Industrial to start yuan business.
newsitem.headline: Japan Industrial to start yuan business.

text.p: The Industrial Bank of Japan will be one of the first two foreign banks to start local Chinese yuan business in Shanghai on Thursday, the Shanghai Securities News said.
The Hongkong & Shanghai Banking Corp will also start to do local currency business on Thursday, the newspaper said.
The head of the Shanghai branch of the People's Bank of China, Mao Yingliang, told a seminar on Wednesday that two banks would begin yuan business before the end of the week, but did not name them.
The newspaper said the two banks would hold ceremonies on Thursday on the signing of their first Chinese yuan loan transactions but gave no details.

"The opening of the Chinese yuan business to foreign banks is an important step in China's financial reforms," the newspaper said. "It helps pave the way for China to join the World Trade Organisation as early as possible."
The newspaper said the foreign banks engaging in local currency business would herald a new round of foreign investment in China, in particular in the Pudong New Area.

"The start of foreign bank local business in Pudong will promote the development of the new area and help Shanghai build itself into an international economic, financial and trade centre," the newspaper said.
